title: 330 East 46th Street #3V
summary: An active-looking RentHop posting advertises $3,100, but earlier snapshots and a separate expired posting show different prices for unit 3V. The payable rent stays unknown until management confirms the current offer.

property.name: 330 East 46th Street
property.availability: Advertised for immediate move-in in the Exa retrieval on Nov 2, 2026. Snapshot age was not supplied; availability is not independently confirmed.

costs.note: Conflicting snapshots show $3,100 and $3,495 for the same posting. Another posting shows $3,450 and is returned as expired. These may reflect changes over time; acquisition timing is incomplete. No single price is treated as confirmed, and all calculated totals remain unknown.

findings.title: Same unit, different prices and dates
findings.detail: The same listing URL returns $3,100 through Exa and $3,495 in an Oct 21 Parallel snapshot. A separate expired posting shows $3,450. These could be price changes or stale records; the current payable amount is unresolved.

findings.title: No-fee does not mean no additional costs
findings.detail: The advertiser says there is no broker fee. Deposit, application charges, utilities, insurance and any amenity fees were not established in the retrieved text. Missing amounts are not zero.

findings.title: Availability needs a current confirmation
findings.detail: The retrieved listing advertises immediate move-in. TinyFish could not refresh the candidate pages because access was blocked; Exa did not supply its acquisition date. No manager has confirmed availability.

findings.title: Official building records not assessed
findings.detail: This report reviews marketplace text only. Complaint and violation records were not queried for this case; no safety or compliance conclusion is drawn.
